flags.reason: The Portfolio Hero guide (e7ed622) says it was checked on 28 October 2026 on the 27 October build, the installed v0.1.78-dbe0e02, but that publish changed only the screen-reader sentence (#346); #403's fix to PortfolioHero.tsx (ace46ca, then dbe0e02; blob 8907545 on c8526ae, d1a9deb installed) is not in the guide. Read against the installed source and its tokens through the package's resolver, three guide statements no longer hold, and the entry leaves them out: (1) States “… and it has no action: Figma’s Action Slot, an icon button beside the amount, isn’t in the package.” and Sources “the package has a fixed label and amount, children for the slot, and no action.”: the package now has topSlot, which replaces or hides the product label, and actionSlot, showAction and onActionPress, which put a control beside the amount (by default a 42 px Icon Button toggle, Emphasis Low, AppearanceBrand Neutral, named “Card”), plus actionActive, actionAccessibilityLabel and accessibilityLabel (PortfolioHero.tsx lines 53–78, 160–189, 210–216); the States title “No states of its own” goes with it, since the default action keeps its own on and off state. (2) Configuration “Slot gap spaces them.” and the Slot gap cards (“Slot gap L … 24 px.”): the slot now reads portfolioHero/slotWrap/gap (line 123), which is 8 px in every Slot gap mode, so Slot gap L leaves 8 px between the badge and the note. (3) In context “the hero has no button of its own”: true of the guide's example, not of the package. Also out of date in the evidence: the Contract's slot/gap and Slot gap lines, “No testID, onPress, accessibility props, or top-area slot”, the Discrepancies' Action Slot / Top Slot and “Unused tokens” lines, and the Limits' “Don't imply the hero presses, has an action button, replaces the chip, …, or that screen readers announce the amount” (on dbe0e02 the amount is announced once, #346). #403 is still In progress for its height item alone. The guide changes when #403 is closed and published (the stale sentences are listed in a note on #403); then re-extract. Added by Claude Code in the overnight run agentpack-r24, for Marcin to confirm.

dismissed.why: The phrase describes the example's own JSX, not the guide's copy: Sell's Button sets modes={{ Emphasis: 'Medium' }} and Buy's sets none.
